title: Equal-wall-clock kick targeting on a fast 2-opt/Or-opt ILS testbed
frozen_at: 2026-11-15 (before any primary run; SHA-256 of this file logged in PROTOCOL.sha256 and in the paper)
engine: 2-opt + Or-opt(1..3, both orientations), 10-NN candidate lists, don't-look-bit queue, better-only acceptance, numba-compiled; JIT compilation excluded by warm-up

strategies.random_global: uniform global double-bridge (operator of the original CRINE-ILS study)
strategies.gnn_global: global double-bridge, each cut w.p. 0.75 on one of m=max(12,int(0.06n)) lowest-probability tour edges of the frozen LKH-GNN
strategies.knn_global: same rule, pool = m tour edges with worst mutual 24-NN rank (training-free proxy)
strategies.random_local: segment double-bridge inside a window of 50 tour positions
strategies.gnn_local: segment double-bridge whose first cut is (w.p. 0.75) a GNN pool edge
strategies.knn_local: segment double-bridge whose first cut is (w.p. 0.75) a kNN-proxy pool edge

pool_refresh: after the incumbent changed, subject to model/proxy time <= 10% of elapsed time; all model time is charged to the budget
start_tour: nearest neighbour from seed-chosen city + full 2-opt/Or-opt; identical for all strategies of an (instance, seed); not charged
common_random_numbers: identical kick RNG seed for all strategies of an (instance, seed); strategy order rotated by seed
primary_set: 38 Waterloo VLSI instances with n<=4000 never used in any earlier experiment of this project (dka1376 ... dkf3954)
metric: percentage gap to the known optimum at 10 s, averaged over seeds within instance; instance is the unit of inference
primary_test: two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank on per-instance mean gap differences; Holm correction over H1-H4; alpha 0.05
equivalence: TOST on per-instance differences with margin +-0.10 percentage points (half of the effect claimed in the earlier draft), paired t on instance means, alpha 0.05 each side; reported for H1-H4
secondary: size strata n<2500 / n>=2500 in the primary set
kicks per second, model overhead, stale-cut rate
exclusions: none; any crash or invalid tour is reported, not dropped
